fullPassage: Even though institutions like the World Bank use wealth to differentiate between “developed” and “developing” countries, they also agree that development is more than economic growth. “Development” can also include the social and environmental changes that are caused by or accompany economic growth, some of which are positive and thus may be negative. Awareness has grown — and continues to grow — that the question of how economic growth is affecting people and the planet needs to be addressed. Countries are slowly learning that it is cheaper and causes much less suffering to try to reduce the harmful effects of an economic activity or project at the beginning, when it is planned, than after the damage appears. To do this is not easy and is always imperfect. But an awareness of the need for such an effort indicates a greater understanding and moral concern than was the previous widespread attitude that focused only on creating new products and services.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) differentiate=구별하다, (B) reduce=줄이다, (C) greater=더 큰/더 많은
det.analysis:
✅ ① differentiate — reduce — greater: 원문 일치. 부(wealth)로 선진국과 개도국을 구별하고(differentiate), 해로운 영향을 줄이며(reduce), 더 큰(greater) 이해를 나타낸다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② combine — reduce — greater: (A) combine(결합하다)은 differentiate(구별하다)의 반대로, 두 종류의 나라를 '구별'한다는 맥락과 모순
❌ ③ differentiate — increase — greater: (B) increase(늘리다)는 reduce(줄이다)의 반대로, 해로운 영향을 '줄인다'는 맥락과 모순
❌ ④ differentiate — reduce — smaller: (C) smaller(더 작은)는 greater(더 큰)의 반대로, '더 큰 이해와 도덕적 관심'이라는 맥락과 모순
det.tip: differentiate between countries(나라를 구별하다) / reduce the harmful effects(해로운 영향을 줄이다) / a greater understanding(더 큰 이해)

❌ ② doubts: doubts(의심하다)는 나타내는 것과 방향이 다른 단어

✅ ④ shows: shows(보여주다)는 indicates(나타내다/보여주다)의 동의어 ←정답
det.tip: indicates = shows = 나타내다, 보여주다

questions.passage: Even though institutions like the World Bank use wealth to differentiate between “developed” and “developing” countries, they also agree that development is more than economic growth. “Development” can also include the social and environmental changes that are caused by or accompany economic growth, some of which are positive and thus may be negative. Awareness has grown — and continues to grow — that the question of how economic growth is affecting people and the planet needs to be addressed. Countries are slowly learning that it is cheaper and causes much less suffering to try to <u>reduce</u> the harmful effects of an economic activity or project at the beginning, when it is planned, than after the damage appears. To do this is not easy and is always imperfect. But an awareness of the need for such an effort indicates a greater understanding and moral concern than was the previous widespread attitude that focused only on creating new products and services.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 reduce와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: reduce=줄이다 → 반의어 increase=늘리다
det.analysis:
❌ ① measure: measure(측정하다)는 양의 증감과 무관한 다른 의미축의 단어
✅ ② increase: increase(늘리다)는 reduce(줄이다)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ③ lessen: lessen(줄이다)은 reduce와 같은 의미의 유의어로 반의어가 아님(소거법 함정)
❌ ④ gather: gather(모으다)는 크기·양의 감소와 다른 의미축의 단어
det.tip: reduce(줄이다) ↔ increase(늘리다) — 양의 증감 대조

questions.passage: Even though institutions like the World Bank use wealth to differentiate between “developed” and “developing” countries, they also agree that development is more than economic growth. “Development” can also include the social and environmental changes that are caused by or accompany economic growth, some of which are positive and thus may be negative. Awareness has grown — and continues to grow — that the question of how economic growth is affecting people and the planet needs to be addressed. Countries are slowly learning that it is cheaper and causes much less suffering to try to reduce the harmful effects of an economic activity or project at the beginning, when it is planned, than after the damage appears. To do this is not easy and is always imperfect. But an awareness of the need for such an effort indicates a <u>greater</u> understanding and moral concern than was the previous widespread attitude that focused only on creating new products and services.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 greater와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: greater=더 큰/더 많은 → 반의어 smaller=더 작은
det.analysis:
❌ ① larger: larger(더 큰)는 greater와 같은 의미의 유의어로 반의어가 아님(소거법 함정)
❌ ② broader: broader(더 넓은)는 폭을 나타내는 유사 개념으로 크기의 반의어가 아님
✅ ③ smaller: smaller(더 작은)는 greater(더 큰)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ④ stronger: stronger(더 강한)는 강도를 나타내는 다른 의미축의 단어
det.tip: greater(더 큰) ↔ smaller(더 작은) — 크기·정도의 대조

questions.passage:
(A) Her main <u>concern</u> was the safety of the children on the field trip.
(B) This new rule <u>concerns</u> all students who live in the school dormitory.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 concern의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: concern: (A) 걱정/우려(명사) — 아이들의 안전에 대한 걱정 / (B) ~에 관련되다/해당되다(동사) — 규칙이 학생들에게 해당됨
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 관련되다 — (B) 관련되다: (A)는 소유격 Her 뒤의 명사로 '걱정/우려'
❌ ② (A) 걱정/우려 — (B) 걱정거리: (B)는 명사가 아니라 주어 뒤의 동사(concerns)
❌ ③ (A) 걱정/우려 — (B) 걱정하다: (B)는 규칙이 학생들을 '걱정하는' 것이 아니라 그들에게 '해당되는' 것
✅ ④ (A) 걱정/우려 — (B) ~에 관련되다/해당되다: (A)는 안전에 대한 명사 걱정, (B)는 주어(rule) 뒤 동사로 '~에게 해당되다' ←정답
det.tip: concern: ① (명사) 걱정/우려 ② (동사) ~에 관련되다/해당되다 — 본문 moral concern = 도덕적 우려(명사)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a large amount of money, property, and valuable possessions that a person or country has"

det.korean: wealth=부/재산 (사람이나 나라가 가진 많은 돈·재산·귀중한 소유물)
det.analysis:
✅ ① wealth: wealth(부/재산)는 '사람이나 나라가 가진 많은 돈, 재산, 귀중한 소유물'이라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② growth: growth(성장)는 크기·양이 커지는 과정으로 소유한 재산을 뜻하지 않음
❌ ③ effort: effort(노력)는 목표를 위한 수고로 재산의 의미가 아님
❌ ④ suffering: suffering(고통)은 겪는 아픔·괴로움으로 재산과 무관함
det.tip: institutions like the World Bank use wealth — 부(wealth)로 나라를 구분

questions.passage: “Development” can also include the social and environmental changes that are __________ (cause) by or accompany economic growth, some of which are positive and thus may be negative.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 'are + 과거분사 + by' 수동태가 필요. cause(동사) → caused(과거분사)
det.analysis: the changes that are __________ (cause) by ... — 관계사절의 주어 the changes가 '야기되는' 대상이므로 be동사(are) 뒤에 수동태 과거분사가 필요. are caused by(~에 의해 야기되다) 구조로 cause → caused가 적절
det.tip: changes that are caused by economic growth — 수동태 are + 과거분사. cause → caused

questions.passage: Awareness has grown — and continues to grow — that the question of how economic growth is __________ (affect) people and the planet needs to be addressed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 'is + 현재분사(-ing)' 현재진행형 능동이 필요. affect(동사) → affecting(현재분사)
det.analysis: how economic growth is __________ (affect) people — 경제 성장이 사람들에게 '영향을 미치고 있는' 능동·진행의 의미이므로 be동사(is) 뒤에 현재분사가 필요. is affecting(영향을 미치고 있다)으로 affect → affecting이 적절. 수동태 affected를 쓰면 '경제 성장이 영향을 받는다'가 되어 의미가 반대가 됨
det.tip: economic growth is affecting people — 현재진행형 be + V-ing. affect → affecting

questions.passage: Even though institutions like the World Bank use wealth to differentiate between “developed” and “developing” countries, they also agree that development is __________. “Development” can also include the social and environmental changes that are caused by or accompany economic growth, some of which are positive and thus may be negative. Awareness has grown — and continues to grow — that the question of how economic growth is affecting people and the planet needs to be addressed. Countries are slowly learning that it is cheaper and causes much less suffering to try to reduce the harmful effects of an economic activity or project at the beginning, when it is planned, than after the damage appears. To do this is not easy and is always imperfect. But an awareness of the need for such an effort indicates a greater understanding and moral concern than was the previous widespread attitude that focused only on creating new products and services.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세계은행조차 발전은 경제 성장 '그 이상(more than economic growth)'임에 동의한다 — 사회적·환경적 변화까지 포함
det.analysis:
❌ ① the same as economic growth: '경제 성장과 같다'는 것은, 발전이 사회적·환경적 변화까지 포함한다는 글 전체 논지와 모순
❌ ② less important than the economy: '경제보다 덜 중요하다'는 본문에서 다루지 않은 비교이며 논지에서 벗어남
✅ ③ more than economic growth: 원문 일치. 발전은 단순한 경제 성장 이상으로 사회적·환경적 변화까지 포함한다는 글의 핵심 주장에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ unrelated to the environment: '환경과 무관하다'는 것은 발전이 환경적 변화를 포함한다는 원문과 정반대로 모순
det.tip: development is more than economic growth — 발전은 경제 성장 그 이상(more than economic growth)

questions.passage: Even though institutions like the World Bank use wealth to differentiate between “developed” and “developing” countries, they also agree that development is more than economic growth. “Development” can also include the social and environmental changes that are caused by or accompany economic growth, some of which are positive and thus may be negative. Awareness has grown — and continues to grow — that the question of how economic growth is affecting people and the planet needs to be addressed. Countries are slowly learning that it is cheaper and causes much less suffering to try to reduce the harmful effects of an economic activity or project at the beginning, when it is planned, than after the damage appears. To do this is not easy and is always imperfect. But an awareness of the need for such an effort indicates __________ than was the previous widespread attitude that focused only on creating new products and services.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그러한 노력의 필요성에 대한 인식은, 새 상품·서비스 창출에만 집중했던 이전 태도보다 '더 큰 이해와 도덕적 관심(a greater understanding and moral concern)'을 나타낸다
det.analysis:
❌ ① a purely economic calculation: '순전히 경제적인 계산'은 도덕적·환경적 배려로 나아간다는 글의 흐름과 반대
❌ ② a weaker sense of responsibility: '더 약한 책임감'은 '더 큰 이해'를 나타낸다는 긍정적 흐름과 모순
❌ ③ less interest in social change: '사회 변화에 대한 관심이 줄었다'는 것은 도덕적 관심이 커졌다는 원문과 모순
✅ ④ a greater understanding and moral concern: 원문 일치. 초기 대응 노력의 필요성에 대한 인식은, 상품 창출에만 집중했던 이전 태도보다 더 큰 이해와 도덕적 관심을 보여준다는 결론에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: indicates a greater understanding and moral concern — 더 큰 이해와 도덕적 관심

ch: a greater understanding and moral concern
